def: An open-source Python framework that reimplements the AlphaEvolve design with a MAP-Elites grid, islands, evaluator cascades and a weighted model ensemble.
Sakana AI's open-source program-evolution framework, built to find good programs with few model calls.
Discarding a candidate program before evaluation when its embedding is too similar to programs already in the archive.
The rule that chooses which stored program a new mutation starts from, balancing fitness against how much that program has already been tried.
Using a bandit algorithm such as UCB1 to learn, from the improvements each model has produced, which model to call for the next mutation.
The periodic exchange of programs between islands so good ideas spread without merging the populations.
The behaviour axes, such as program complexity, that define the cells of a MAP-Elites archive in a framework like OpenEvolve.
A summary, written periodically by a model, of which strategies have worked in recent generations, appended to later mutation prompts.
How much improvement a search obtains per model call or evaluation spent, which depends on what is counted as a sample.
